items.label: node:http server
items.details: Ephemeral port, JSON in/out, graceful close

items.label: Idempotency filter
items.details: Key lookup, fingerprint compare, replay 200 / KEY_REUSED 409

items.label: Error envelope
items.details: One shape for every non-2xx; 503 on retry budget exhausted

items.label: Time-zone resolver
items.details: Local wall time + IANA zone to UTC; 15-min offset scan; 0 candidates = gap, 2 = ambiguous, fold disambiguates

items.label: Slot grid
items.details: Expands a booking into the 15-min quanta it covers; duration must be a positive multiple of 15

items.label: Booking write path
items.details: Reserve, cancel, read. Every write inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Multi-table bookings are one transaction

items.label: Availability search
items.details: Stage 2. Read side of the same guarantee

items.label: occupancy PK (table, quantum)
items.details: THE GUARANTEE. Overlapping bookings share a quantum and collide in the store

items.label: idempotency_key
items.details: PK on key alone; a retry is a replay, not a second booking

items.label: Migration runner
items.details: schema_migration ledger, idempotent, no ad hoc DDL from handlers

items.label: Multi-process race
items.details: 12+ separate OS processes, one file, one slot: exactly 1 x 201 and 11 x 409

items.label: Duplicate delivery
items.details: Same key 10x concurrently: one booking, rest replays

items.label: DST and offset suite
items.details: Spring gap, fall overlap, fold, sub-hour offsets; passes under hostile ambient TZ

items.label: Atomicity harness
items.details: Two tables, one taken: zero occupancy rows, zero booking rows, zero key rows
